exposure: Race/ethnicity (Caucasian, African-American, Hispanic, Asian, Native American)
cohort: 87,076 women undergoing cesarean section with perioperative epidural catheter placement from the National Inpatient Sample (NIS) database (2003-2013)
finding: Adverse maternal outcomes of hematoma, blood transfusion, cardiac arrest, and ventricular fibrillation occurred more frequently in minority groups undergoing cesarean sections with epidural catheter placements throughout the period of 2003-2013.
